page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Main text in one full-width column. Marginal notes in the left margin beside the first lines of the text (Gen. 49.13, 14.15, Gen. 49.20). Catchword-like heading at the foot: a verse heading "32 Filiis Nephtali exiuit sors sexta," with catchword "filiis" at the right.

main_text.p: nium suffragio occupat tribus Zabulon, sed regio mari cotigua diuinitus facta est eius hereditas. Ita, quanuis errarint homines: lux tamen semper in tenebris fulgida apparuit. Logius progreditur Iacob, & illustre discrimen statuit inter Zabulon & Issachar: quod prior tribus negotiandi causa varie discurret: altera autem in suis tabernaculis otium colet ac vitam sedentariam. Ergo probabile est tractum maris, vbi Zabulon consedit fuisse portuosum, & aptum ad multiplices commeatus. Gen. 49.13. 14.15Filios autem Issachar contentos fuisse suo prouentu, & fructus quos perceperant ex labore suo & cultura, domi comedisse. Qui regionum illarum periti existimantur, afferunt agrum tribus Aser fuisse frumentarium: quod optimo consensu atque optimo concentu respondet vaticinio Iacob. Quod non nisi exiguus vrbium numerus exprimitur, hinc rursum coniicere licet multas tunc fuisse ruinas quae non venirent in rationem, & ex quo populus commode habitauit, extructas fuisse multas vrbes, quibus terra fuisse ornatam ex aliis locis patet. Et certe appareret, summam diuisionis breuiter fuisse perstrictam, atque ita multa praetermissa, quae inuestiga re nulla religio vetat, modo ne curiositas fine fructu molesta sit. Certe quibus hic viginti vrbes vel septemdecim tribuuntur, latius dominati sunt. Ergo compendium diuisionis tantum hic narratur, quale sumptum fuit ex tumultuario nuntiorum commentario.

page.notes: Marginal references in the left margin: "Gen. 49.13. 14.15" beside the paragraph on Zabulon and Issachar; "Gen. 49.20" beside the paragraph on Aser. Left-margin note reproduced inline at its place; the second note is shown as a foot paragraph. Show-through and the faint mark at top left are not transcribed. Heading "32 Filiis Nephtali exiuit sors sexta," is a verse line at the foot and is not a heading; it is omitted from main_text pending confirmation of the layout.
